discrepancies.translation_text: I will show you when you are out
discrepancies.explanation: The Kannada phrase refers to showing ejaculation/orgasm ('out'), which is mistranslated literally as 'when you are out'.
The speaker asks 'Married?' but the translation says 'Is it yours?'.
The speaker asks 'Won't we meet in real?' but the translation completely changes this to 'will you be on WhatsApp?'.

policy_moments.translation_text: I will give you my WhatsApp number. Video call me and pay

summary: The translation captures the exchange of the phone number and payment details, but fails to accurately translate the explicit sexual reference ('out' meaning ejaculation) and the final request to meet in person.
